A '''Dug cavalier'''<ref name="ZBEG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode218.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Zillo Beast}}</ref> was a type of [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that served in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare's]] armed forces during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Dug cavaliers rode<ref name="TZB" /> [[Insectomorph/Legends|insectomorph]]<ref name="ZBEG" /> creatures on [[Saddle/Legends|saddles]], wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and used [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaves]]. The cavaliers saw service in the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]]<ref name="TZB" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref><ref name="FF-2014 8: Geonosis">{{FactFile2014|8|21 BBY 1-2|The Second Battle of Geonosis}}</ref> when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] tried to conquer the world. Together with their allies, the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the cavaliers fought the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], but the Dug cavalry charges proved ineffective against the firepower of the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and they suffered heavy casualties. The allies nevertheless won the battle due to the use of an [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]] that deactivated the Separatist forces. However, the explosion of the bomb awakened an ancient [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] creature that wreaked havoc in the allied armies before it could be subdued.<ref name="TZB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dug cavaliers first appeared in "[[The Zillo Beast]]," the eighteenth episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Season Two]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which was aired on [[April 3]], [[2010]]. Although they were not named in the episode, the cavaliers received a title in its corresponding [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|episode guide]] on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="ZBEG" />
